citationText: 19. Memo to Hutchinson from Kennedy, Feb. 20, 1914 , the Edison employee who was approached was a Mr. Hammond; this memo expressed great concern about Gaumont possibly overcoming their having to record close to the horn, which was regarded as Kinetophone's significant competitive advantage.
